Subject: BrightPath - Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Hi Sam / Elena —

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about BrightPath's evaluation goals and timelines. As discussed, I put together a Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the key milestones, owners, and target dates we talked through:

- Technical spike / perf benchmark: BrightPath (Elena) — target week of Jun 14
- Security review: BrightPath (IT security) — target Jun 21
- Procurement / contract review: Legal / Procurement — target Jun 28
- Pilot kick-off / sandbox access: Redwood (Marissa) & BrightPath (Elena) — target Jul 5

Could you please:
1) Confirm the owners and whether these dates look realistic for your side
2) Share any additional stakeholders I should include on the MAP (security contact, procurement lead)

Attached: BrightPath-MAP-v1.pdf — this is editable; happy to update in real-time if you want to walk through it. If it helps, I can also share a calendar with proposed checkpoint meetings.

Next best steps from my side: once owners/dates are confirmed I'll open the sandbox and priority slots for our dedicated perf run and loop in our security engineer for the questionnaire.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the reminder and for offering the artifacts — that would be very helpful. We reviewed the MAP internally and have the following:

- Confirmed owners: Elena will own the technical spike and security review; I will own procurement and exec sponsor alignment.
- Adjusted dates: Technical spike week of Jun 14 (OK), Security review targeted Jun 25 (moved one week earlier), Procurement review now Jul 2, Pilot kick-off Jul 12 (as suggested).
- Security artifacts: see attached spreadsheet with our security contacts and the list of items we need — if you can share the SOC 2 scope and retention policy, Elena can start the intake.

We should be in a position to sign procurement by Jul 2 if there are no major redlines. I'll send a calendar invite for a joint checkpoint the week of Jun 21 to confirm progress.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Sam
VP Product Operations | BrightPath
